items:
⭐ More than a Stay™. Elite VIP Experience Package – Enjoy daily FREE Golf, Parasailing, Crab Island Excursion, Sunset Dolphin Cruise, Water Park, Bikes and More Activities EVERY DAY of Your Stay! Up to $1,150 in daily value. (Details Below) ⭐

Experience the pinnacle of coastal luxury at Seawalk Sanctuary, a brand-new 6,608-square-foot beachfront masterpiece in Seagrove Beach, completed in Spring 2023. From the moment you enter, you'll be captivated by the grandeur of expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that showcase the mesmerizing emerald Gulf waters. High wood-beamed ceilings and premium finishes create an atmosphere of sophisticated elegance and serene relaxation, while every detail—from the gourmet kitchen to the refined design elements—has been meticulously curated to offer an unparalleled Gulf-front living experience.

Step outside into a world of indulgence and tranquility. Begin your mornings with the soothing sounds of waves from your private stretch of beach, accessible via a secluded walkway. Spend your afternoons unwinding in the rooftop heated pool, surrounded by panoramic ocean views, or retreat to the second heated pool on the back patio for a peaceful escape. With complimentary beach service and six bicycles at your disposal, exploring the pristine coastline is effortless and enjoyable.

Designed to host up to 22 guests in absolute comfort, Seawalk Sanctuary features five stunning king suites, a custom bunk room, and luxurious bathrooms, ensuring ample space and privacy for everyone. Whether you're savoring breathtaking sunsets from the rooftop, gathering in the open living areas, or enjoying quiet moments on one of the many private balconies, this home provides the perfect sanctuary for creating unforgettable memories.

Seawalk Sanctuary seamlessly blends elegance, comfort, and the natural beauty of Seagrove Beach, making it the ultimate destination for your dream coastal escape. Book your stay now and immerse yourself in the luxurious Seagrove Beach lifestyle, where every moment is crafted for relaxation and joy.

WHY GUESTS 💙 SEAWALK SANCTUARY
🔹 Beachfront with Private Walkway to the Beach
🔹 Heated* Rooftop Pool
🔹 Covered Heated* Back Patio Pool
🔹 2 Bikes Included
🔹 Beach Chair Service - 2 Umbrellas & 4 Chairs (Seasonal)
🔹 4 Beach Chairs Provided in the Home
🔹 Beach Towels Provided

🩴👙 THE LIVING EXPERIENCE:

🔹 FIRST FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 2)
The journey begins on the first floor, where a serene king bedroom opens directly to the pool patio, offering a private retreat with its own en-suite and thoughtful built-in storage. The cozy living room, complete with a wet bar and mini fridge, invites you to unwind with stunning views of the pool and easy access to the beach. Practical touches like a laundry room, elevator, and a full bath with outdoor access ensure comfort and convenience, while the two-car garage stands ready for all your coastal adventures.

- King Bedroom with Sliding Door to the Pool and Side Door Entrance with an En-suite Bathroom
- Living Room with Large Sliding Door to the Patio & Pool and Access to the Beach
- Wet Bar With Mini Fridge
- Elevator
- Two-Car Garage
- Laundry Room
- Full Bathroom with Shower Accessible from the Outside

🔹SECOND FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 16)
This floor is a haven for relaxation and fun, designed with breathtaking Gulf views and ample space for everyone. The master king suite exudes luxury, featuring a wet bar, balcony access, and a spa-like en-suite with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Another king bedroom shares the spectacular views and balcony access, while the bunk room, with built-in bunks and trundles, offers a playful retreat for kids or extra guests. A spacious shared bathroom and a second laundry room complete this floor, blending practicality with elegance.

- Master King Bedroom with Wet Bar, Double Sliding Doors to the Balcony with Gulf Views and an En-suite Bathroom
- King Bedroom with Gulf Views, Shared Balcony Access, and an En-suite Bathroom
- Bunk Room with 2 Built-In Queen/Queen Bunks and 2 Built-In Twin Beds with Twin Trundles
- Full Bathroom
- Laundry Room

🔹THIRD FLOOR EXPERIENCE: (Sleeps 2)
The heart of the home is on the third floor, where the expansive gourmet kitchen and open-concept living areas are designed for gathering and entertaining. Large sliding doors frame spectacular Gulf views, seamlessly connecting the indoor and outdoor spaces. The dining area, complete with a cozy nook and dual wet bars, is perfect for enjoying meals together, while the elegant king suite provides a private escape with its luxurious en-suite and additional laundry facilities.

- Gourmet Kitchen with Seating for 5 at the Counter
- Living Room with Gulf Views and Double Sliders to Balcony
- Dining Area with Balcony Access, Wet Bar with Wine Cooler and a Cozy Nook with Table and Seating for 8
- Pantry with Fridge and Microwave
- Hall Half Bath with Separate Water Closet
- King Bedroom with an En-suite Bathroom and Stacked Washer and Dryer

🔹FOURTH FLOOR EXPERIENCE:
The rooftop oasis crowns this stunning home, offering a heated pool, lounge area, and breathtaking panoramic views of the Gulf. A king suite with ensuite bathroom ensures privacy and comfort, while the rooftop living room, wet bar, and balcony create a dreamy space for both relaxation and celebration. With endless vistas and unparalleled luxury, this level is the ultimate retreat.

- Rooftop Pool and Lounge Area
- King Bedroom with Gulf and Pool Views and an En-suite Bathroom
- Wet Bar
- Half Bath
- Living Room with Gulf Views and Slider to Balcony and Pool

🔹PARKING: There are parking accommodations for 4-5 vehicles. Please note overnight parking on the street is not permitted.

🏖️ THE BEACH EXPERIENCE:

The beach is truly your backyard, inviting you to wake up to the soothing sound of waves and spend your days basking in the sun, building sandcastles, or taking refreshing dips in the Gulf. Just steps from your door, this unparalleled access ensures every moment of your getaway is filled with the beauty of the ocean, creating memories that will last a lifetime.

⛵ THE VIP EXPERIENCE​​​​​​​:

⭐ Your vacation should be EPIC— so vacation like a VIP with FREE activities every day!

Elevate your vacation with the Elite Experience Package, designed for those who seek adventure, relaxation, and unforgettable memories. As our guest, you'll enjoy up to $1,150 in complimentary daily activities—because your getaway should be nothing short of extraordinary.

🔹Two Tickets Per Day For:
🏖️ Big Kahuna's Water Park – Splash into fun with slides, wave pools & lazy rivers
⛳ Glow-in-the-Dark Mini Golf – A unique indoor putting adventure
🐬 Dolphin Cruise, Sunset Cruise & Snorkeling – Choose your perfect ocean excursion
🧗 Indoor Air Adventure Park – Platinum access to trampolines, climbing walls & more
🚲 Two Complimentary Bikes – Explore the area at your own pace

🔹One Ticket Per Day For:
🌴 Crab Island Tiki Boat Cruise – Cruise to the famous sandbar on a floating tiki bar
🏌️ Championship Golf Rounds – Tee off at Emerald Bay, Regatta Bay, Shalimar Pointe, or Windswept Dunes
🪂 Parasailing – Soar high above the Gulf for breathtaking views
🎣 Fishing Excursion – Reel in Snapper, Grouper & more

✨ 10+ Free Activities Daily | Up to $1,150 Value | No Extra Cost – Just Our Gift to You! You'll receive all the details on reserving your activities in your confirmation email. Please note, some activities may be seasonal.

🌞 DREAM VACATION, ENHANCED:
✔️ *Pool heating is available for $100 per day (payment required for the duration of your stay).
✔️ Complimentary beach service- 2 umbrellas & 4 chairs (Mar 1- Oct 31)
✔️ High-speed, reliable internet to ensure you stay connected for work or streaming.
✔️ Access to live TV on every TV, featuring a wide selection of movies, shows, sports, and news for endless entertainment.
✔️ A personalized welcome and/or thoughtful gift provided during your stay.
✔️ Convenient starter packs provided with essentials such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dish soap, shampoos, and laundry detergent. (Additional items may need to be purchased)
✔️ Fresh, clean, and soft linens are provided for every stay, laundered in our in-house facility after each check-out.
✔️ Peace of mind with a $3,000 accidental damage waiver (with a $100 deductible). Some exclusions apply.
✔️ VIP services available for an added touch of convenience, including babysitting, grocery delivery, entertainment options, & more.

🐟 MEET YOUR HOST:

Destin Dreamers is your go-to choice for luxury vacation rentals in Destin, Miramar Beach, and 30A. Our motto, “Celebrating life, dreaming fully awake,” reflects our true way of life. For us, every day is a gift from God, and we cherish the time spent with friends and family. While it may seem simple, living fully awake and embracing each moment is something we consciously strive for. After thriving as a custom home builder in Colorado for 15 years, Chris Harper and his family moved to the stunning Emerald Coast. It was here that Destin Dreamers was born. Our vision is clear: to offer guests the chance to celebrate life, dreaming fully awake.

Our dedicated team is available on-site daily or reachable via call or text from 8 AM to 5 PM, six days a week, with support for emergencies on Sundays and after hours.

*Person booking must be over 25 and stay each night. No exceptions. See rental agreement for more info.

*Please be aware that some furniture may have been updated since the last photos were taken.
